description: Block dangerous shell commands (rm -rf, sudo, chmod 777, fork bomb)

hooks.command: INPUT=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm\s+-rf\s+/|sudo\s|chmod\s+777|mkfs\.|dd\s+if=|:\(\)\{|fork\s+bomb)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected: $INPUT" && exit 1; fi; exit 0
